newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schenker strikes Mercosur logistics deal.
newsitem.headline: Schenker strikes Mercosur logistics deal.

text.p: Schenker International said it has increased South America logistics services through an agreement with Argentine forwarder Transportes Ader S.A.(TASA).
Schenker Argentina and TASA now offer complete door-to-door forwarding, warehousing and distribution services for the Mercosur customs union, a statement from parent company Schenker-Rhenus AG said.
The two companies already coordinate the consolidation and multi-modal transport for Yamaha Music Argentina S.A. of imports from the U.S. and various Asian countries, it added.

This covers computer-based monitoring of import fee payment, transport insurance, customs clearance, freight forwarding from airports and sea ports to the TASA terminal and distribution to Yamaha dealers and clients.
All jobs are carried out within 24 hours, Schenker-Rhenus claimed.
TASA Logistica, which has 450 staff, 420 trucks and operates a 150,000 square metres covered warehouse, has a high reputation in Argentina, it added.
The Mercosur agreement covers Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay and Paraguay.

Schenker International is one of the world's largest transport and logistics services companies for air and sea cargo with 650 locations worldwide. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
